svg.title: Momoli LinkedIn company cover — Built to pull its weight.
svg.metadata: Origin: Momoli flat brand artwork created 2026-09-28 from the supplied symbol and its small-size favicon adaptation, using Barlow Condensed and Geist. Original compositions were code-authored, with outlined lettering; no generated imagery. Curated into the standalone branding repository on 2026-09-29. This SVG is the retained vector master; see docs/BRAND.md and README.md. The former brand-kit generator is not part of this repository.

g.aria-label: Custom software, from screen to system.
